title: I'm really impressed, wish I had gotten one of these years ago
text:
I'm really impressed, wish I had gotten one of these years ago. I can't believe how much longer my bread stays fresh with this box.
I use to get a new loaf of bread and separate it and freeze half because it would go stale before we got it eaten,there are just 2 of us.
Now I can put the whole loaf in it, put hot dog buns and muffins, plus we keep our butter in it, it holds alot, none of it has gotten stale or moldy.
It's really looks nice on the counter but doesn't take up alot of room.

product_metadata.title: Brabantia Roll Top Bread Box (Matt Steel Fingerprint Proof) Large Front Opening Flat Top Bread Box, Fits 2 Loaves, Ideal for Kitchen Counter
